review_scope: Compared every one of the 23 rendered views with the merged F02 baseline for physical surface qualification. The largest mean RGB difference is 12.77/255 in the F06B kitchen, where the visible wall effect is stronger. The roof view shows the renewed stair guard; separate installed probes verified six joints and actual standing clearance.
